ICS: Acknowledging that psychological pain is very close to physical pain (validating)
Allowing the emotion to open and then effectively moving to different areas
Allowing the time to listen—this may be the $1 ^ { \mathrm { s t } }$ time this person has revealed the incident to an authority. It is worth taking the time to listen.
Reflecting your understanding of the situation to the patient
Identifying changeable behaviors (don’t ding a patient for personality)
Negative Questioning: “You aren’t feeling guilty are you?”
Labeling: “Were you drinking at the time?”
Assumptions: “Have you had many other sexual partners while in service?”
Minimizing: Any indication to the patient that you think she is exaggerating
